canonical_name: Supply Chain Security Practices Not Integrated into Acquisitions
description: Supply chain security practices are not integrated into acquisitions.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Organizations with supplier and third-party relationships Procurement and vendor management teams Supply chain security programs

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for the absence of supply chain security practices in acquisition processes and lifecycle management. Check for lack of performance monitoring of security practices throughout the technology product and service lifecycle.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls
